name: Voxel Data Planar De-interleaving
aliases: Struct of Arrays (SoA) for Global Memory
definition: Converts an Array of Structures (AoS) of FVoxelData into a Structure of Arrays (SoA) planar format for compression.
summary: Voxel Data Planar De-interleaving converts voxel data from an Array of Structures to a Structure of Arrays planar format, enabling compression and data reduction for volume rendering.
